reason: No proposal addresses routes importing models vs repository. Most routes.js delegate to controllers; areas/comments/projects import models only for numericIdParam, tasks/routes.js calls Project.findAll directly.

No proposal about module file layout. Modules live under backend/modules/<feature>/ with routes.js, but many lack repository.js and use controller.js/service.js instead; only tasks has core/serializers/builders/parsers.
No proposal about hasAccess middleware. Shareable resources (tasks, projects, notes, comments, people) use hasAccess; owner-only modules like goals/areas do not.
D-6c856c forbids requests to computed URLs in components, a weaker form of 'no ad-hoc fetch, use services' and excludes hooks. About 38 of 367 component/hook files still call fetch().
No proposal about Zustand/SWR/useState. Zustand useStore is widely used but SWR is not used anywhere in frontend, so the server-data part is not followed.
No proposal about source languages per area. frontend has only .ts/.tsx (plus css), backend has only .js.
No proposal about async/await vs callbacks/.then(). No err-first callbacks found; about 15 .then() chains remain in non-test backend code.

No proposal about routes requiring models. Four routes.js require ../../models; only tasks/routes.js calls model methods directly (Project.findAll, Task.STATUS), others just pass models to numericIdParam.

Route handlers live almost entirely in module controller.js files (routes.js are thin); D-744c2d requires controller exports to use try, covering where the try/catch rule applies. Code follows it in 33/35 controllers and tasks/routes.js.
D-744c2d only requires try, not forwarding to next(error). Most controllers call next(error); backup, mcp, oidc, telegram, url controllers and tasks/routes.js respond ad hoc with 500/400.
No proposal about HTTP status codes. Handlers generally use 400/404/403 appropriately, with some catch-all 400s for server errors in tasks routes.
No proposal about custom error classes. About 600 throws use custom error classes vs about 160 'throw new Error(' in non-test backend code.
No proposal about singleton service exports. Only 2 *Service.js files export 'new XService()'; most export plain objects with module.exports = {...}.
No proposal about functional vs class components. No class components extending React.Component found.
No proposal about Tailwind usage. Components style with Tailwind utility classes in className.
No proposal about clsx/classnames. Neither library is imported anywhere; about 206 component files use template-literal className expressions.
No proposal about color palette usage. ColorPicker derives from PALETTE; a few components (calendar views) still hard-code hex colors.
No proposal about hashColor. Comments and templates use hashColor; utils/avatarTint.ts implements a separate hash-based tint for avatars.
No proposal about accentVars/ACCENT classes. accentVars is used in a handful of user-colored components; extent hard to verify fully.
No proposal about FORM classes. Only about 14 files use FORM.* while about 89 component files render raw <input> and 19 <select>.
No proposal about backend file naming. All *Service.js files are camelCase and operations/queries files are kebab-case or single lowercase words.
No proposal about component naming. 322 of 327 non-test .tsx files are PascalCase; exceptions are hook files, index.tsx and widgets.tsx.
No proposal about function naming (D-57d79e is a validate* prefix, not casing). No snake_case function declarations found; functions are camelCase apart from PascalCase components.
No proposal about class naming. All ~100 class declarations are PascalCase.
No proposal about constant naming. About 590 top-level literal constants are UPPER_SNAKE_CASE vs about 34 camelCase ones (e.g. dayMs, cell).
No proposal about variable naming. Declared variables are overwhelmingly camelCase; snake_case appears mainly in destructured request/DB fields.
No proposal about table names. All tableName values are lowercase snake_case; a few are singular (auth_audit_log, feedback, user_mfa, caldav_sync_state).
No proposal about column names. Model attributes are snake_case (due_date, user_id); no camelCase attribute definitions found.
No proposal about interface naming. All ~600 interface declarations start with an uppercase letter.
No proposal about type alias naming. All ~106 type aliases are PascalCase.
No proposal about route path naming. Only tasks/tags/comments use singular /x/:uid; areas, goals, habits, people, views, calendar-feeds, webhooks use plural /xs/:uid.
No proposal about collection paths. Collection routes are plural (GET /tasks, /areas, /goals) and filter via query parameters.
No proposal about PATCH vs PUT. About 19 router.put routes remain, including resource updates such as PUT /habits/:uid, /goals/:uid, /admin/users/:id.
No proposal about task tags/project task listing. Tags are updated via updateTaskTags from the task body and GET /tasks scopes by project_uid; no separate tags or project-tasks endpoint found.
No proposal about numericIdParam. Registered in areas, comments, projects, tasks; cannot tell which other modules accept numeric ids.
No proposal about 201/204 statuses. Controllers use 201 for creates and 204 for deletes; tasks DELETE returns 200 with a message.
No proposal about error JSON shape. About 195 error responses use { error } vs 3 using { message }.
No proposal about thin routes. Most routes.js only wire controllers; tasks/routes.js holds large inline business logic.

D-57d79e (validation files hold validate* functions) covers only the validation.js part of the compound responsibility rule. tasks core/serializers.js also queries the DB and validation files contain non-validators.
No proposal about TaskForm sections. TaskForm/ contains one file per section.
No proposal about test placement. All component tests are in __tests__/ directories (only two utils tests sit outside).
No proposal about backend test layout. Unit tests are under category dirs (one flat file); integration tests are flat except an mcp/ subdirectory.
No proposal about test structure. Tests use describe blocks, but only about 1580 of 4860 it/test cases start with 'should'.
D-57d79e is about validator naming, not throwing ValidationError. Validation modules generally throw ValidationError; tasks routes still return ad-hoc 400s.
No proposal about raw SQL. Raw sequelize.query is used in ~11 files with replacements; some interpolate identifiers/constants (search repository table names, relations RESOLVED_STATUSES).
No proposal about password hashing. User model hashes password into password_digest with bcrypt.
No proposal about dangerouslySetInnerHTML. The only use (MermaidDiagram) relies on mermaid strict mode, not DOMPurify.sanitize().
No proposal about N+1 queries. Includes are used widely, but per-row queries cannot be ruled out without runtime analysis.
No proposal about route path plurality. Collections are plural but most single-resource routes are also plural (/areas/:uid, /goals/:uid, /habits/:uid).
D-744c2d covers the try/catch half of the compound rule but not forwarding with next(error). Most controllers do both; several controllers and tasks/routes.js handle errors ad hoc.
No proposal about hasAccess. Shared resource routes use hasAccess; owner-only modules rely on service-level user scoping.
No proposal about serializers. Only tasks has core/serializers.js; other modules return service results directly.
No proposal about builders. Only tasks uses core/builders.js; other modules pass req.body to services.
No proposal about circular module imports. tasks imports daily-plan and daily-plan imports tasks, so a cycle may exist; cannot confirm without resolving the full graph.
No proposal about router registration. app.js registers module routers for both /api and the versioned base path.
No proposal about swagger schemas. swagger.js has schemas for only about 8 resources (Task, Project, Note, Tag, InboxItem, Area, ApiKey) of ~45 modules.
No proposal about permissionSources. permissionSources is used in ~11 files; a few repositories/services still query Permission directly.
No proposal about component directories. Shared components are in Shared/ and features in their own dirs; several feature components sit at the components/ root.
No proposal about functional components. No class components found.
No proposal about entity interfaces. Core entities are in frontend/entities/; some resource types are defined in service files.
D-6c856c restricts computed-URL requests in components but does not state where API client functions live. ~50 *Service.ts files exist, though some components still fetch directly.
No proposal about hook location. Most hooks are in frontend/hooks/, but several live in component directories.
No proposal about context location. Two providers are in contexts/, two others are under components/.
No proposal about service worker notifications. App.tsx calls notifySwSession on login and notifySwClearCache on logout, Navbar calls notifySwClearCache.
No proposal about TypeScript adoption (D-9998f9 concerns return types only). The backend is entirely JavaScript, including recent code.
No proposal about functional components with hooks. No class components found.
D-9998f9 is about function return types, not props interfaces. ~265 *Props interfaces and no *Props type aliases.
No proposal about component placement. Components are under frontend/components/ (App/Layout aside).
No proposal about async/await. No callback-style APIs found; a few .then() chains remain.
D-57d79e is about validator naming, not validation middleware. Validation is called from services/index modules, not as route middleware; no validation middleware library used.
No proposal about database clients. Data access goes through Sequelize models or the Sequelize instance; no raw drivers found.
No proposal about route file location. There is no backend/routes/ directory; routes live in backend/modules/*/routes.js.
No proposal about business logic location. Most business logic lives in backend/modules/*/service.js, not backend/services/.
No proposal about secrets. No hard-coded secret/API-key literals found in source.
No proposal about SQL parameterization. Raw SQL uses replacements or sequelize.escape for values; interpolation is limited to internal identifiers.
No proposal about backend test location. No backend *.test.js outside backend/tests/.
No proposal about frontend test placement. Tests sit in __tests__/ next to components and are named *.test.tsx (some *.test.ts).
No proposal about Arrange-Act-Assert. AAA structure cannot be measured reliably by grep.
No proposal about migrations. No active migrations exist in backend/migrations/ (only archived 1.x ones), so the scope has no code.
No proposal about migration transactions. backend/migrations/ has no active migration files.
No proposal about translations. English has the most keys (3450) and every other locale is a subset.
No proposal about translation key naming. Keys are nested descriptive names.
D-f7d289 is about hook ordering (useTranslation before useState), not banning hard-coded text. Most components use t(), with some hard-coded strings.
No proposal about mocking. jest.mock appears in 72 test files, 23 of them mocking emailService.
No proposal about msw. No frontend test uses msw; tests mock fetch globally instead.
No proposal about edge-case test files. Auth/authorization edge-case tests are in *-edge-cases.test.js under backend/tests/unit.
No proposal about unit test structure. Unit tests mirror source dirs (modules, services, middleware), with a few flat files.
No proposal about safeCreateTable. No active migrations in backend/migrations/.
No proposal about safeAddColumns. No active migrations in backend/migrations/.
No proposal about safeAddIndex. No active migrations in backend/migrations/.
No proposal about safeRemoveColumn/safeChangeColumn. No active migrations in backend/migrations/.
No proposal about business logic placement. Most modules keep logic in service.js; tasks/routes.js holds substantial inline logic.
No proposal about TypeScript components. All components are .tsx.
No proposal about Zustand/SWR. Zustand is used but SWR is absent from the frontend.
No proposal about model location. Models are defined in backend/models/ with associations in models/index.js.
No proposal about permissionSources. Mostly used; a few places query Permission directly.
No proposal about migration file naming. No active migration files in backend/migrations/ (archived ones follow the pattern).
No proposal about down(). No active migrations in backend/migrations/.
No proposal about migration transactions. No active migrations in backend/migrations/.
No proposal about migration placement. No new 2.x migrations exist yet; archive holds only 1.x migrations.
No proposal about migration/model parity. No active migrations to compare.
No proposal about safe* helpers. No active migrations in backend/migrations/.
No proposal about boolean literals. No active migrations, and raw SQL samples contain no boolean comparisons to judge.
No proposal about JSON column binding. oidc auditService writes JSON.stringify(metadata) into a DataTypes.JSON column; otherwise objects are bound.
No proposal about quoting identifiers. Raw SQL quotes mixed-case aliases ("Tag"."id", "Task"."project_id").
No proposal about safeChangeColumn. No active migrations in backend/migrations/.
No proposal about migration idempotency. No active migrations in backend/migrations/.
No proposal about model index declarations. No active migrations to compare against models.
No proposal about locale parity. About 392 of 3450 English keys are missing from every other locale.
No proposal about TaskForm sections. Date/defer/recurrence fields are separate section components in TaskForm/.
No proposal about permissionSources. Mostly used; a handful of services/repositories query Permission directly.
No proposal about offline queued responses. About 30 of 50 *Service.ts files use isQueuedOfflineResponse/handleAuthResponse.
No proposal about the service worker. sw.js has no NO_CACHE_PATHS blocklist in handleApiGet.
No proposal about AI completions. service.js calls chat.completions.create with getAIModel; response_format may be json_schema with fallback to json_object.
D-744c2d only requires try in controllers, not auth checks or next(error). Each ai-assistant controller method checks userId and calls next(error).
D-9998f9 requires return types across frontend but does not place AI client functions in aiAssistantService.ts. That file exists and holds the AI client.
No proposal about AI component location. AI components are in frontend/components/AI/.
No proposal about spreadsheet imports. Imports use buildTaskAttributes/buildUpdateAttributes; updates pass skipWebhooks only when task.user_id === userId.
No proposal about email locales. All locales have the English keys except 7 missing in id/jp/ko/vi/zh (likely plural suffix forms).
No proposal about email registration. Emails are registered in emails/index.js and sent via renderEmail.
